question: Who ceases to undergo the fruit of past karma?
premises: A higher consciousness can arise that burns up the fruit of accumulated past karma.
Even a single such consciousness may arise in someone.
That person no longer undergoes karmic fruit in the usual way.
inference: One in whom a higher consciousness arises that consumes past karmic fruit is no longer bound to experience that fruit.
plain_english: And so, if even a single higher consciousness arises in someone, consisting in the burning up of the fruit of the mass of past karma, that person does not undergo that fruit.
